question: In a pedigree of an autosomal dominant trait it is observed that:

options.opa: The trait appears more frequently in males.
options.opb: The unaffected people do not transmit the trait.
options.opc: The trait tends to skip generations.
options.opd: The affected people have both affected parents.
options.ope: The trait tends to appear in the progeny of related parents.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: ope. The trait tends to appear in the progeny of related parents. -> opc. The trait tends to skip generations. -> opa. The trait appears more frequently in males. -> opd. The affected people have both affected parents. -> opb. The unaffected people do not transmit the trait. -> 80%

CHAIN: opd. The affected people have both affected parents. -> opb. The unaffected people do not transmit the trait. -> opc. The trait tends to skip generations. -> ope. The trait tends to appear in the progeny of related parents. -> opa. The trait appears more frequently in males. -> 75%
